description: Build an HTTP Link response-header value from one or more URL/rel pairs (preload, preconnect, prefetch, canonical, pagination, etc.), including the as/type/crossorigin attributes preload needs, with a plain-English explanation of each entry and warnings for common mistakes like a preload missing `as`. Pure string assembly and lookup; it never fetches or validates that a URL exists.

as.description: Resource type hint, mainly used with preload/modulepreload

type.description: MIME type of the linked resource

name: build_link_header
